title.text: Red Dune Desert: 60-Minute Dune Buggy Ride, Sandboarding & BBQ Buffet Dinner

pills.label: 60 min driving
pills.pop_html: Buggy time: A full hour on the dunes, the longest drive on this page alongside the 1000cc tours. A guide leads the route and sets a pace you are comfortable with, and you can stop for a breather and refreshments mid-ride.

pills.label: Twin-seat buggy
pills.pop_html: The buggy: Two-seater with a full roll cage, bucket seats and a full safety harness. You can ride solo or as a couple sharing one buggy for the hour.

pills.label: BBQ camp option
pills.pop_html: After the drive: Optional, at extra cost: a 4x4 transfer to a Bedouin camp for a 2.5-hour evening with BBQ buffet, belly dance and Tanoura shows, henna, shisha, Arabic coffee and soft drinks, depending on the option you pick.

pills.label: Pickup included
pills.pop_html: Transport: Pickup and drop-off in central Dubai, with Sharjah and Ajman as alternative pickup points. About 45 minutes each way by Jeep/SUV.

best_for.pick_html: for drivers who want a full hour at the wheel on the Red Dunes with a guide setting the lines, because it pairs the longest drive with pickup from Dubai, Sharjah or Ajman and an optional BBQ camp
best_for.skip_html: if anyone in your group is under 16, or if you only want the drive and not a 4–7 hour evening

items.a: Pickup and drop-off in central Dubai, dune buggy ride; BBQ dinner, shows, shisha, camel ride, henna and soft drinks depending on option.
Alcoholic drinks, souvenir photos, tips.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Children under 16, pregnant women, people with back or heart problems, wheelchair users.
English, Hindi, Urdu.

title.text: Excursion Point: Desert Safari with 30-Minute Self-Drive Dune Buggy, Sandboarding & Camel Ride

pills.label: 30 min self-drive
pills.pop_html: Buggy time: A 30-minute self-drive session at Excursion Point's own Adventure Hub area. Works out to €1.41 per buggy minute, the lowest on this page.

pills.label: 4-seat buggy
pills.pop_html: Who drives: Each buggy takes 1 driver and up to 3 passengers. One person drives the whole session while the others ride along, so it suits families more than groups who all want the wheel.

pills.label: Dune bashing too
pills.pop_html: Also included: 40 minutes of 4x4 dune bashing on the Red Dunes, 30 minutes of sandboarding, a 10-minute camel ride, and tea, coffee and dates in the Majlis.

pills.label: Evening option
pills.pop_html: Dinner: Eligible evening packages add a camp dinner with live entertainment and fire shows; in winter there may be an outdoor bonfire. A quad bike ride is an optional extra.

best_for.pick_html: for families and budget travellers who want a real self-drive buggy session plus dune bashing for about €42, because nothing else here gets you behind a buggy wheel for less
best_for.skip_html: if everyone in your group wants to drive, since one buggy has one driver and three passengers

Dubai, Sharjah or Ajman.
Transfer (45 min), Adventure Hub break, dune bashing (40 min), sandboarding (30 min), optional quad bike (30 min), camel ride (10 min).

title.text: Kings and Queens: Private 1-Hour Polaris RZR 1000cc Buggy Safari, Camel Ride & Private Transport

pills.label: Polaris RZR 1000cc
pills.pop_html: The buggy: A Polaris 1000cc Sport buggy with 4-wheel drive, the most powerful class on this page. Helmet and goggles are provided free.

pills.label: 60 min, swap at 30
pills.pop_html: Driving time: A 1-hour ride for two. After the first 30 minutes you switch seats with your partner, so each of you drives for 30 minutes.

pills.label: Fully private
pills.pop_html: No other guests: Transport, buggy ride and camel ride are all private, with your own licensed guide who adapts the pace to your driving. You do not share with other customers at any point.

pills.label: Base camp
pills.pop_html: Facilities: Air-conditioned lounge, outdoor seating with desert views, cafeteria, prayer rooms and a supermarket. Food and supermarket items cost extra; bottled water is included.

best_for.pick_html: for couples who want a 1000cc buggy, a guide and a car to themselves, because at about €111 each it is the only fully private option here and costs less per head than the shared #1 tour
best_for.skip_html: if you want a BBQ dinner and shows, or if you are travelling solo and would pay the full €222 for one person

items.a: 1-hour private buggy ride in a 1000cc RZR, private pickup and drop-off, sandboarding, camel ride, licensed private guide, bottled water, helmet and goggles, safety instruction.
Food and supermarket items.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Children under 4, pregnant women, people with mobility impairments, wheelchair users.

title.text: 1-Hour Self-Drive 1000cc Dune Buggy, Sandboarding & Camel Ride, Optional BBQ Camp

pills.label: 1000cc, 1 hour
pills.pop_html: The drive: You drive a 1000cc buggy yourself for an hour on the Lehbab dunes, after kitting up and a briefing from the safari captain. €1.63 per minute at the from-price.

pills.label: 4 or 6 hours
pills.pop_html: Two lengths: The 4-hour version ends after buggy and sandboarding. The 6-hour version continues to Al Khayma Desert Camp for a camel ride, henna, falcon show, shisha and BBQ dinner.

pills.label: Ages 10+
pills.pop_html: Who can join: Not suitable for children under 10, a lower limit than the 16+ tours. Under-12s must ride the camel with an adult.

pills.label: Hotel pickup
pills.pop_html: Transport: Pickup and drop-off from your hotel in an air-conditioned vehicle, plus unlimited soft drinks and water.

best_for.pick_html: for drivers who want a full hour in a 1000cc buggy for under €100, because it matches the #1 pick's wheel time for about €40 less
best_for.skip_html: if your travel insurance does not cover motorsports, since the drive is at your own risk and the provider's insurance does not cover accidents

items.a: Hotel pickup and drop-off, air-conditioned vehicle, expert instructor, 1000cc dune buggy ride, helmet, sandboarding, short camel ride, camel feeding, unlimited soft drinks and water; welcome coffee, henna, shisha, BBQ dinner and live shows on the 6-hour tour only.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Children under 10, pregnant women, people with back or heart problems, wheelchair users.
Al Khayma Desert Camp (6-hour tour).
Comfortable shoes, sunglasses, sun hat, sunscreen, comfortable clothes.

title.text: Red Dunes Safari with Optional Self-Drive Dune Buggy, Sandboarding, Camel Ride & BBQ

pills.label: Buggy is an option
pills.pop_html: Read this first: The €27 from-price is the safari without the buggy. The self-drive buggy is included only if you select that option, and its price and minutes show in the booking options.

pills.label: 30–45 min dune bashing
pills.pop_html: Also included: 30 to 45 minutes of dune bashing with a trained driver in an air-conditioned 4WD, plus sandboarding and a camel ride you can repeat.

pills.label: BBQ on 7-hour tour
pills.pop_html: Camp evening: The 7-hour version adds the desert camp: rose water and Arabic coffee welcome, falcons, henna, shisha, entertainment shows and a BBQ with vegetarian options.

pills.label: Unlimited soft drinks
pills.pop_html: Refreshments: Tea and coffee with dates and unlimited soft drinks in a cool tent after the camel ride. Hotel pickup and drop-off in Dubai included.

best_for.pick_html: for groups where only one or two people want to drive, because everyone else pays the €27 safari price and only the drivers add the buggy
best_for.skip_html: if the buggy is your main reason to go: the add-on adds cost and the drive time is not fixed in the from-price

items.a: Hotel pickup and drop-off, air-conditioned 4WD, English-speaking driver, dune bashing (30–45 min), sandboarding, camel ride, tea/coffee with dates, unlimited soft drinks; self-drive buggy if option selected; BBQ, gahwa and sweets on the 7-hour option.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Dubai.
From €27 per person (buggy extra). The final price for your date is shown before you pay.
English.

title.text: Red Dunes Self-Drive Quad Bike or Dune Buggy, Sandboarding, Camel Ride & Falcons

pills.label: 1–2 hours total
pills.pop_html: Time commitment: The shortest trip here: briefing, a guided drive through the red dunes with a sandboarding break at the halfway point, a camel ride, then falcons and drinks back at base.

pills.label: Quad or buggy
pills.pop_html: Choose your machine: Self-ride quad bike or dune buggy. The from-price is the entry option, so check the buggy option's price when you pick a date.

pills.label: Sharjah meeting point
pills.pop_html: Getting there: Desert Adventure Motorcycle Rentals in Al Qasimia City, Industrial 1, Sharjah. Hotel pickup is not part of this tour, so plan a taxi.

pills.label: Drivers 16+
pills.pop_html: Age rules: Minimum age 14; ages 14 to 16 must be accompanied by an adult, and drivers need to be 16+ with basic driving knowledge. Everyone signs a waiver.

best_for.pick_html: for travellers who want a quick self-drive session in an afternoon, because it is done in 1–2 hours instead of eating a whole evening
best_for.skip_html: if you need hotel pickup, or if you want an exact number of driving minutes before you book

items.a: Self-ride quad bike or dune buggy, instructor, sandboarding, short camel ride, photo stop, falcon photos, refreshments, training and safety briefing, helmet.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Desert Adventure Motorcycle Rentals, XM9V+HQ, Al Qasimia City, Industrial 1, Sharjah.

title.text: 360 Adventures: 1000cc Dune Buggy or Quad Bike, Optional Transfer & Desert Camp

pills.label: Quad or 1000cc buggy
pills.pop_html: Machines: 250cc or 320cc quad bikes, or a 1000cc dune buggy. The €24 from-price is the entry option; the buggy is its own option with its own price.

pills.label: 30 min ride
pills.pop_html: Riding time: The itinerary lists a 30-minute quad ride on the Lehbab red dunes after a safety briefing; buggy minutes are not stated, with a helmet compulsory the whole time.

pills.label: Transfer optional
pills.pop_html: Getting there: Return transport is an option, not standard. There is no public transport or Uber from the site, so either add the transfer or drive yourself.

pills.label: Camp option
pills.pop_html: Evening add-on: The desert camp option adds tea, coffee and dates, a BBQ buffet with vegetarian dishes, belly dance, Khaliji and Tanoura dance and a fire show. Sandboarding comes with selected options.

best_for.pick_html: for self-drivers with a rental car who want the lowest possible price for a ride on the Lehbab dunes
best_for.skip_html: if you have no car and do not add the transfer: there is no Uber or public transport back from the site
